[EN] I will never lose a senior officer again.

And I will make sure this place safe from any threat by not allowing even the smallest weakness.
[ES] Nunca volveré a perder a un oficial superior.

Y me aseguraré de que este lugar esté a salvo de cualquier amenaza sin permitir ni la más mínima debilidad.

[EN] Commander Helkan! I have good news!
[ES] ¡Comandante Helkan! ¡Tengo buenas noticias!

[EN] The argons have retreated from Tirkai Forest.
[ES] Los argons se han retirado de Tirkai Forest.

[EN] It's not known why, but they all just disappeared all of a sudden!
[ES] ¡No se sabe por qué, pero simplemente desaparecieron de repente!
